sources.citation: Pelkey, Jamin R. 2011. A Phula Comparative Lexicon: Phola, Phuza, Muji, Phowa, Azha. SIL Language and Culture Documentation and Description 18. Dallas: SIL International. 144 pp.
sources.access_detail: a copy the project holds (available on request)
sources.note: Silent. Sec. 3.1 'Phola phonology in brief' pp. 4-6 describes Phola-LDC (Luodie, ypg): {(C)(V)VTP} template, 45 onsets, 13 vowels, five tones 55/33/31/23/52, tense phonation; 'stress'/'accent' occur 0 times in the book. Alo Phola appears only as a name on the clade map/list p.3; no Alo data.
